'''Norch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He, alongside [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tekla Ansgar]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Rojo Trace]], was part of the team that investigate a crashed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. He was a very bureaucratic man and argued with Trace.
